# Ambiguous-Requirement Scenario (SCN-C) Checklist: Agentic Software Engineering System: URL Shortener

**Purpose**: Validate that the SCN-C requirements ('track who clicks links') specify detection, classification, clarification, lineage and every non-happy outcome.
**Created**: 2026-10-15
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md) · [plan.md](../plan.md) · [ADRs](../../../docs/adr/README.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.
**Item tags**: `[Mandatory]` means the criterion derives from the constitution, an approved requirement, or an accepted ADR or ruling. `[Optional]` means it concerns an enhancement. `[Dnn]` refers to a detection from the checklist brief; the detection map is in [../gates/release-evidence-gates.md](../gates/release-evidence-gates.md). Post-implementation evidence checks are in that gates file, not here. Every item is unchecked, including `[Optional]` items, so `/speckit-implement` reports this file as incomplete until a reviewer marks it.

## Requirement Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 Is the SCN-C input fixed verbatim ("track who clicks links")? [Clarity, HD-002] [Mandatory]
- [ ] CHK002 Is it specified which stages must not start while the ambiguity is unresolved? [Completeness, Spec §SCN-C-AC2] [Mandatory]
- [ ] CHK003 Are the clarification questions and options specified, including the recommended option and the consequence of each? [Completeness, Spec §SCN-C-AC3; Plan §11.3] [Mandatory]
- [ ] CHK004 Is decision lineage specified from question to answer to re-versioned artifacts? [Completeness, Spec §SCN-C-AC3, §SCN-C-AC4, §FR-ORC-013] [D05] [Mandatory]
- [ ] CHK005 Is the retention of daily buckets (clarification question Q2) specified? [Gap, Plan §11.3] [Mandatory]

## Requirement Clarity

- [ ] CHK006 Are the four ambiguity classifications defined with objective criteria for each? [Clarity, Spec §SCN-C-AC1] [Mandatory]
- [ ] CHK007 Is "resume at the earliest affected stage" defined objectively? [Measurability, Spec §SCN-C-AC4; ADR-017] [D21] [Mandatory]
- [ ] CHK008 Is "never proceeds on a guessed interpretation" made testable (no ST-06 or later node READY while the clarification gate is open)? [Measurability, Spec §SCN-C-AC5; workflow-graph.v2.yaml G-CLARIFY] [Mandatory]

## Scenario and Edge Case Coverage

- [ ] CHK009 Is each non-happy outcome specified: unanswered (timeout → SAFE_STOPPED), rejected (rework or terminate), and an answer that violates policy without an exception (PRIV-001 FAIL → SAFE_STOPPED)? [Coverage, Spec §SCN-C-AC5] [D15] [D09] [Mandatory]
- [ ] CHK010 Is option B (personal data) routed through the exception workflow, with a defined outcome if the exception is rejected? [Coverage, Spec §FR-SHR-023, §FR-GOV-007] [D10] [Mandatory]

## Requirement Consistency

- [ ] CHK011 Is the conforming option A capability (daily aggregate counts) bounded so it stays within EXC-005 and FR-SHR-012? [Consistency, PD-008; Spec §EXC-005, §FR-SHR-012] [Mandatory]
- [ ] CHK012 Is the SCN-C required-evidence list consistent with the amended SC-002? [Consistency, Spec §SCN-C; Spec §SC-002 (CR-003)] [Mandatory]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation
- `/speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `/speckit-specify` and `/speckit-clarify`
- `[Gap]` = the requirement is missing; `[Ambiguity]` = the term or rule needs a definition; `[Conflict]` = two sources disagree; `[Assumption]` = relies on an unvalidated assumption
